articles.title: IFC and OTP Bank sign deal to support €100mn in Ukrainian business loans
articles.summary: The International Finance Corporation (IFC) and Ukraine’s OTP Bank have signed a risk-sharing agreement covering up to €100mn in new loans to Ukrainian businesses, with a focus on renewable energy, energy efficiency and climate-smart agriculture, reported Ukraine Business News. Under the agreement, backed by the European Commission, the IFC, a member of the World Bank Group, will cover up to 50% of the credit risk on eligible new loans issued by OTP Bank.

articles.title: Novartis (SWX:NOVN) Posted Positive Phase III ORION 4 Results In ASCVD
articles.summary: Novartis (SWX:NOVN) reported positive topline Phase III ORION-4 results for Leqvio in patients with established ASCVD. The trial, a large cardiovascular outcomes study, found Leqvio reduced major adverse cardiovascular events in secondary prevention patients. ORION-4 provides the first clinical cardiovascular outcomes evidence for this siRNA therapy in a broad real world ASCVD population.
